title: How to Split a Bill Evenly, Fast
description: Simple division for splitting a restaurant bill evenly among friends, no calculator needed.
narration_lines: Splitting a bill evenly is simple division.
The total bill comes to 60 dollars.
Divide that by how many people are splitting it. 60 divided by 4.

steps.label: Divide by the number of people

params.footnote: just divide the total by how many people are splitting it
